name: studioos-service
description: Native backend for the Adi Studio OS Stream Deck plugin: virtual MIDI, OS keystroke/volume/zoom/app routing, smart-home. Runs on the Stream Deck app's bundled Node 20.
comment: No npm dependencies by design. The WebSocket server is hand-rolled (service/ws-server.js) and the MIDI natives are committed prebuilds in service/vendor/, so installing never compiles or downloads anything.
